ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Thread Creation By Uncommon Source Image
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon processes creating remote threads. Note: Unmapped fields: SourceImage, TargetImage, TargetParentProcessId, SourceCommandLine, SourceParentImage

sequences.query: (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\explorer\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\powerpnt\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR SourceImage = RGX("\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\winlogon\.exe" AND (TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\services\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\wininit\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\csrss\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\LogonUI\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\wlrmdr\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\AtBroker\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\dwm\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\fontdrvhost\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\userinit\.exe")) OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\winlogon\.exe" AND TargetParentProcessId = 4) OR ((SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\schtasks\.exe" OR SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\schtasks\.exe") AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\conhost\.exe") OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" AND (TargetImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR TargetImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR TargetImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR TargetImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\"))) OR TargetImage = "System" OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") AND (TargetImage = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Microsoft\\\.NET\\\\Framework64\\\\.*"))) OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\msiexec\\\.exe$") AND (TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\msiexec\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\msiexec\.exe")) OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe" AND (TargetImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Internet\ Explorer\\iexplore\.exe" OR TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\rundll32\.exe")) OR (SourceImage = RGX("\\\\POWERPNT\\\.EXE$") AND (TargetImage = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\.*") OR TargetImage = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\.*"))) OR TargetImage = "None" OR TargetImage = "") AND  NOT ((SourceImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\internet\ explorer\\iexplore\.exe" AND (SourceCommandLine = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*") AND SourceCommandLine = RGX(".*\\\.checkpoint\\\.com\\/documents\\/.*") AND SourceCommandLine = RGX(".*SmartConsole\\_OLH\\/.*") AND SourceCommandLine = RGX(".*default\\\.htm\\#cshid\\=.*"))) OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\internet\ explorer\\iexplore\.exe" AND (SourceParentImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\") OR SourceParentImage = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\")) AND (SourceParentImage = RGX(".*\\\\CheckPoint\\\\SmartConsole\\\\.*") AND SourceParentImage = RGX(".*\\\\SmartConsole\\\.exe.*"))) OR (SourceImage = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\.*") AND SourceImage = RGX("\\\\POWERPNT\\\.EXE$") AND TargetImage = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\csrss\.exe") OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\OneDrive\\\\OneDrive\\\.exe$")) OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\aurora\\-dashboard\\\.exe$")) OR (SourceImage = "C\:\\Windows\\explorer\.exe" AND TargetImage = RGX("\\\\OfficeSetup\\\.exe$")))
